verdict.rationale: Rainforest documents amount splits configured on a payin, and each split routes a fixed amount or a rate-based allocation to the platform (the developer's cut) or to a specified merchant. That covers splitting one charge across multiple sellers plus a platform cut. Nothing in the evidence shows reversing or adjusting a split after the fact, or splits existing as standalone first-class API objects. missing for 10: reversal or adjustment of splits after the charge, evidence that splits are first-class API resources, explicit multi-seller support on a single charge, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a developer, I can split one charge among any set of parties — route funds to multiple sellers, take my cut, and reverse or adjust the split later, all as first-class API objects

citations.quote: Each split routes a defined amount or rate-based allocation to the platform or specified merchant.
You can implement amount splits in three steps: Configure the payin to apply the amount splits
